```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ---- GNPC code release ---------------------------------------------------------
# Makes: Fig. 4a-e and Extended Data Fig. 2-3 -- validation of the predicted sex,
#   APOE genotype, age and MMSE against the measured values in GNPC, by site and
#   by tissue (plasma / CSF), with summary statistics.
# Inputs:  PROTEOMICS_RDS and PREDICTED_RDS (set in config.R).
# Outputs: step_dir("01_validation").
# Runs on the AD Workbench (the GNPC data stay there). From the repository root:
#   Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("01_validation/01_validation.Rmd", knit_root_dir = getwd())'
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 8
)

# Load all required packages in one place
required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "data.table", "pROC", "ggplot2", "tidyverse", 
  "PRROC", "SummarizedExperiment", "scales", "gridExtra", 
  "reshape2", "corrplot", "grid", "viridis", "ggpubr"
)

# Install missing packages
new_packages <- required_packages[!required_packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"]]
if(length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

# Load all packages
invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

source("config.R")

# Create results directory if it doesn't exist
output_dir <- paste0(step_dir("01_validation"), "/")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Introduction

This document compares predicted and measured values across contributor groups (sites) and tissues. We calculate accuracy and confusion matrices for the classifications, and correlation and error statistics for the continuous measures, for four predicted measures:

1. Sex
2. APOE genotype
3. Age
4. Mini-Mental State Exam (MMSE) score

## Helper Functions

First, let's define some helper functions to avoid code repetition and improve readability.

```{r helper-functions}
# Function to format contributor labels
format_contributor_label <- function(code) {
  sample_type <- gsub(".+ ", "", gsub(".+_", "", code))
  contributor <- gsub("_.+", "", code)
  return(paste0(sample_type, " (", contributor, ")"))
}

# Function to create tissue labels
create_tissue_label <- function(contributor_label) {
  tissue <- gsub(" \\(.+", "", contributor_label)
  return(factor(tissue, levels = c("Plasma", "CSF")))
}

# Function to calculate regression statistics
calc_regression_stats <- function(actual, predicted) {
  abs_error <- abs(predicted - actual)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((predicted - actual)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae <- mean(abs_error, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(list(rmse = rmse, mae = mae))
}

# Function for creating comparison scatter plots
create_comparison_plot <- function(data, x_var, y_var, x_label, y_label, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  stats_by_contributor <- data %>%
    group_by(contributor_label) %>%
    summarize(
      rmse = sqrt(mean((!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var))^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mae = mean(abs(!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var)), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = !!sym(x_var), y = !!sym(y_var))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.2, color = "gray30") +
    geom_bin_2d(bins = 40, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#0072B2", fill = "#0072B240", size = 1) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top", 
             size = 3, color = "black", digits = 2) +
    geom_text(
      data = stats_by_contributor,
      aes(label = sprintf("RMSE: %.2f\nMAE: %.2f", rmse, mae)),
      x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
      size = 2.5, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ contributor_label, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", name = "Count", direction = -1) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray70"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = -10),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, face = "italic"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 15, b = 10, l = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      caption = "Note: Dashed line represents perfect prediction (y=x). Blue line shows linear regression with 95% confidence interval.
      RMSE = Root Mean Square Error; MAE = Mean Absolute Error. Higher density of observations shown in darker colors."
    )
  
  return(p)
}

create_comparison_plot <- function(data, x_var, y_var, x_label, y_label, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  stats_by_contributor <- data %>%
    group_by(contributor_label) %>%
    summarize(
      rmse = sqrt(mean((!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var))^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mae = mean(abs(!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var)), na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),  # Add sample size calculation
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = !!sym(x_var), y = !!sym(y_var))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.2, color = "gray30") +
    geom_bin_2d(bins = 40, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#0072B2", fill = "#0072B240", size = 1) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top", 
             size = 3, color = "black", digits = 2) +
    geom_text(
      data = stats_by_contributor,
      aes(label = sprintf("n = %d\nRMSE: %.2f\nMAE: %.2f", n, rmse, mae)),  # Add n to the label
      x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
      size = 2.5, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ contributor_label, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", name = "Count", direction = -1) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray70"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = -10),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, face = "italic"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 15, b = 10, l = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      caption = "Note: Dashed line represents perfect prediction (y=x). Blue line shows linear regression with 95% confidence interval.
      RMSE = Root Mean Square Error; MAE = Mean Absolute Error. Higher density of observations shown in darker colors."
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to save plot with standard settings
save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 12, height = 10,...) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",...
  )
}
```

## Data Loading and Preparation

Now we'll load the proteomics data and prediction results.

```{r load-data}
# Load proteomics data
expdata_path <- PROTEOMICS_RDS
if (!file.exists(expdata_path)) {
  stop(paste("Proteomics data file not found at:", expdata_path))
}
expdata <- readRDS(expdata_path)
metadata <- colData(expdata) %>% as.data.frame()

# Load prediction data
prediction_path <- PREDICTED_RDS
if (!file.exists(prediction_path)) {
  stop(paste("Prediction data file not found at:", prediction_path))
}
pp <- read_predicted_phenotypes(prediction_path)
prediction <- get_prediction(pp, "no_class_labels")

# Join metadata and prediction data
data <- metadata %>%
  inner_join(prediction, by = "sample_id")

# Drop the excluded contributors (config.R)
data <- data %>%
  filter(!contributor_code %in% EXCLUDED_CONTRIBUTORS)

# Add sample matrix to contributor code for more detailed analysis
data$contributor_code <- paste0(data$contributor_code, "_", data$sample_matrix)

# Create control flag
data$control <- !rowAnys(data %>%
  select(all_of(c("pd", "als", "ad", "ftd", "stroke"))) %>%
  as.matrix() == "1")

# Filter APOE data
apoe_data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(APOE)) %>%
  filter(APOE != "-1")

# Standardize APOE genotype order (e.g., "32" becomes "23")
data$APOE[data$APOE %in% "32"] <- "23"
```

## Sex Analysis

Next, we'll analyze SEX prediction accuracy across different contributors.

```{r load-sex-predictions}
# Predicted sex (class labels of T0002)
sex_predictions <- get_class_labels(pp, "T0002")

# Calculate sex prediction accuracy by contributor
sex_acc_by_contributor <- data %>%
  select(sample_id, sex, contributor_code) %>%
  inner_join(sex_predictions, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  filter(sex != "-1") %>%
  mutate(sex=2-sex)%>%
  group_by(contributor_code) %>%
  summarise(ACC = sum(sex == prediction) / n())

print("SEX Prediction Accuracy by Contributor:")
print(sex_acc_by_contributor)
```


### SEX Confusion Matrix Analysis

Let's create comprehensive confusion matrices to visualize SEX prediction accuracy.

```{r sex-confusion-matrices}
# Create the confusion matrix dataframe
conf_norm_df <- data %>%
  select(sample_id, sex, contributor_code) %>%
  inner_join(sex_predictions, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  filter(sex != "-1") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Actual = sex, Predicted = prediction) %>%
  group_by(contributor_code, Actual, Predicted) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Actual, contributor_code) %>%
  mutate(Normalized = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()

class_names <- unique(conf_norm_df$Actual)

# Convert to factors with the right order
conf_norm_df$Actual <- factor(conf_norm_df$Actual, levels = class_names)
conf_norm_df$Predicted <- factor(2-conf_norm_df$Predicted, levels = class_names)

# Create a complete grid with all combinations
all_combinations <- expand.grid(
  Actual = levels(conf_norm_df$Actual),
  Predicted = levels(conf_norm_df$Actual),
  contributor_code = unique(conf_norm_df$contributor_code),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Convert to tibble for easier manipulation
all_combinations <- as_tibble(all_combinations)

# Join with existing data
complete_conf_df <- left_join(
  all_combinations,
  conf_norm_df %>% select(Actual, Predicted, contributor_code, Count),
  by = c("Actual", "Predicted", "contributor_code")
)

# Replace NA values with zeros for Count
complete_conf_df <- complete_conf_df %>%
  mutate(Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)) %>%
  group_by(Actual, contributor_code) %>%
  mutate(Normalized = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Normalized = replace(Normalized, is.na(Normalized), 0))

# Sex code mapping for more readable labels (GNPC: 1 = male, 2 = female; the
# predicted labels were converted to the same coding above with 2 - prediction)
apoe_map <- c(
  "1" = "Male",
  "2" = "Female"
)

# Apply the mapping
complete_conf_df$Actual <- apoe_map[complete_conf_df$Actual]
complete_conf_df$Predicted <- apoe_map[complete_conf_df$Predicted]

# Format contributor codes for readability
complete_conf_df$contributor_code <- complete_conf_df$contributor_code %>%
  gsub(".+ ", "", .) %>%
  gsub(".+_", "", .) %>%
  paste0(., " (", complete_conf_df$contributor_code %>% gsub("_.+", "", .), ")")

# Calculate accuracy per contributor
accuracy_df <- complete_conf_df %>%
  group_by(contributor_code) %>%
  summarise(
    Correct = sum(Count[Actual == Predicted]),
    Total = sum(Count),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Set color palette
color_palette <- "Blues"
complete_conf_df = complete_conf_df %>% filter(!grepl("Serum",contributor_code))
```

### SEX Confusion Matrix Visualization

Now let's visualize the confusion matrices by contributor and tissue type.

```{r sex-confusion-matrix-plots}
# Create ordered factor for proper display order
contributor_levels <- c(
  complete_conf_df$contributor_code %>% unique() %>% .[grepl("Plasma", .)],
  complete_conf_df$contributor_code %>% unique() %>% .[grepl("CSF", .)]
)

# Create plot by contributor with n and accuracy in the facet labels
norm_plot_by_contributor <- ggplot(
  complete_conf_df%>%mutate(contributor_code = factor(contributor_code, levels = contributor_levels)),
  aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Normalized)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Normalized), 
                color = ifelse(Normalized > 0.5, "white", "black")), 
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = color_palette, direction = 1, labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Row-Normalized Confusion Matrix (Recall Perspective)",
    x = "Predicted sex",
    y = "Actual sex",
    fill = "Proportion"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~contributor_code, labeller = labeller(contributor_code = function(x) {
    acc <- accuracy_df$Accuracy[match(x, accuracy_df$contributor_code)]
    n <- accuracy_df$Total[match(x, accuracy_df$contributor_code)]
    paste0(x, "\nn = ", n, " | Accuracy: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", acc * 100))
  }))

# Save the plot
save_plot(norm_plot_by_contributor, "Sex_norm_plot_by_contributor.png", width = 15, height = 12)
save_plot(norm_plot_by_contributor, "Sex_norm_plot_by_contributor.pdf", width = 15, height = 12)

fwrite(accuracy_df,paste0(output_dir,"sex_prediction_accuracy_by_contributors.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
fwrite(complete_conf_df,paste0(output_dir,"sex_prediction_confusion_matrix_by_contributors.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

# Create summary by tissue type
tissue_summary_df <- complete_conf_df %>%
  mutate(tissue = gsub(" \\(.+", "", contributor_code)) %>%
  group_by(Actual, tissue, Predicted) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Actual, tissue) %>%
  mutate(Normalized = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Normalized = replace(Normalized, is.na(Normalized), 0))

# Calculate accuracy per tissue
tissue_accuracy_df <- tissue_summary_df %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    Correct = sum(Count[Actual == Predicted]),
    Total = sum(Count),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot by tissue with accuracy
norm_plot_by_tissue <- ggplot(
  tissue_summary_df %>% mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Plasma", "CSF"))),
  aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Normalized)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  # Change text color based on darkness of fill
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Normalized), 
                color = ifelse(Normalized > 0.5, "white", "black")), 
            size = 6) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = color_palette, direction = 1, labels = percent_format()) +
  # Add scale for text colors with no legend
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Row-Normalized Confusion Matrix by Tissue Type",
    x = "Predicted sex",
    y = "Actual sex",
    fill = "Proportion"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tissue, labeller = labeller(tissue = function(x) {
    acc <- tissue_accuracy_df$Accuracy[match(x, tissue_accuracy_df$tissue)]
    n <- tissue_accuracy_df$Total[match(x, tissue_accuracy_df$tissue)]
    paste0(x, "\nn = ", n, " | Accuracy: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", acc * 100))
  }))
# Save the plot
save_plot(norm_plot_by_tissue, "Sex_norm_plot_by_tissue.png", width = 8, height = 4)
save_plot(norm_plot_by_tissue, "Sex_norm_plot_by_tissue.pdf", width = 8, height = 4)
fwrite(tissue_accuracy_df,paste0(output_dir,"sex_prediction_accuracy_by_tissue.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
fwrite(tissue_summary_df,paste0(output_dir,"sex_prediction_confusion_matrix_by_tissue.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
```


## APOE Genotype Analysis

Next, we'll analyze APOE genotype prediction accuracy across different contributors.

```{r load-apoe-predictions}
# Predicted APOE genotype (class labels of T0607)
apoe_predictions <- get_class_labels(pp, "T0607")

# Calculate APOE prediction accuracy by contributor

  select(sample_id, APOE, contributor_code) %>%
  inner_join(apoe_predictions, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(APOE)) %>%
  filter(APOE != "-1") %>%
  group_by(contributor_code) %>%
  summarise(ACC = sum(APOE == prediction) / n())

print("APOE Prediction Accuracy by Contributor:")
print(apoe_acc_by_contributor)
```

```{r apoe-confusion-matrix-plots}
save_plot(norm_plot_by_contributor, "APOE_norm_plot_by_contributor.pdf",device = cairo_pdf)

fwrite(accuracy_df,paste0(output_dir,"apoe_prediction_accuracy_by_contributors.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
fwrite(complete_conf_df,paste0(output_dir,"apoe_prediction_confusion_matrix_by_contributors.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

# Create summary by tissue type
tissue_summary_df <- complete_conf_df %>%
  mutate(tissue = gsub(" \\(.+", "", contributor_code)) %>%
  group_by(Actual, tissue, Predicted) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Actual, tissue) %>%
  mutate(Normalized = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Normalized = replace(Normalized, is.na(Normalized), 0))

# Calculate accuracy per tissue
tissue_accuracy_df <- tissue_summary_df %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    Correct = sum(Count[Actual == Predicted]),
    Total = sum(Count),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot by tissue with accuracy
norm_plot_by_tissue <- ggplot(
  tissue_summary_df %>% mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Plasma", "CSF"))),
  aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Normalized)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Normalized), 
                color = ifelse(Normalized > 0.5, "white", "black")), 
            size = 3) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = color_palette, direction = 1, labels = percent_format()) +
    scale_color_identity() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Row-Normalized Confusion Matrix by Tissue Type",
    x = "Predicted APOE genotype",
    y = "Actual APOE genotype",
    fill = "Proportion"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tissue, labeller = labeller(tissue = function(x) {
    acc <- tissue_accuracy_df$Accuracy[match(x, tissue_accuracy_df$tissue)]
    n <- tissue_accuracy_df$Total[match(x, tissue_accuracy_df$tissue)]
    paste0(x, "\nn = ", n, " | Accuracy: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", acc * 100))
  }))

# Save the plot
save_plot(norm_plot_by_tissue, "APOE_norm_plot_by_tissue.png", width = 8, height = 4)
save_plot(norm_plot_by_tissue, "APOE_norm_plot_by_tissue.pdf", width = 8, height = 4,device = cairo_pdf)
fwrite(tissue_accuracy_df,paste0(output_dir,"apoe_prediction_accuracy_by_tissue.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
fwrite(tissue_summary_df,paste0(output_dir,"apoe_prediction_confusion_matrix_by_tissue.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
```

## Age Prediction Analysis

Next, we'll analyze the accuracy of age prediction models across different contributors.

```{r age-prediction-analysis}
# Prepare data for age prediction analysis
age_data <- data %>%
  # Create more informative contributor labels
  mutate(contributor_label = format_contributor_label(contributor_code)) %>%
  # Filter out serum samples
  filter(!grepl("Serum", contributor_code)) %>%
  # Create ordered factor for proper display order
  mutate(contributor_label = factor(
    contributor_label,
    levels = c(
      unique(contributor_label) %>% sort() %>% .[grepl("Plasma", .)],
      unique(contributor_label) %>% sort() %>% .[grepl("CSF", .)]
    )
  )) %>%
  # Select relevant columns
  select(sample_id, age_at_visit, contributor_label, T0001) %>%
  # Remove missing or invalid age values
  filter(!is.na(age_at_visit), age_at_visit != -1) %>%
  # Calculate error metrics
  mutate(abs_error = abs(T0001 - age_at_visit))

# Create age prediction plot by contributor
age_plot <- create_comparison_plot(
  data = age_data,
  x_var = "age_at_visit",
  y_var = "T0001",
  x_label = "Chronological Age (years)",
  y_label = "Predicted Age (years)",
  title = "Relationship Between Chronological and Predicted Age",
  subtitle = "Analysis of age prediction accuracy across different contributor sources"
)

# Save the plot
save_plot(age_plot, "Age_plot.png")
save_plot(age_plot, "Age_plot.pdf")

x_var = "age_at_visit"
y_var = "T0001"
stats_by_contributor <- age_data %>%
  group_by(contributor_label) %>%
  summarize(
    rmse = sqrt(mean((!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var))^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mae = mean(abs(!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var)), na.rm = TRUE),
    cor = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$estimate,
    cor_ci_lo = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$conf.int[1],
    cor_ci_hi = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$conf.int[2],
    cor_t = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$statistic,
    cor_df = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$parameter,
    cor_p = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$p.value,
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
fwrite(stats_by_contributor,paste0(output_dir,"age_prediction_accuracy_by_contributors.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

# Create age prediction plot by tissue type
age_tissue_data <- age_data %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = gsub(" \\(.+", "", contributor_label),
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Plasma", "CSF"))
  )

# Calculate statistics per tissue including sample size
age_tissue_stats <- age_tissue_data %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  summarize(
    rmse = sqrt(mean((T0001 - age_at_visit)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mae = mean(abs(T0001 - age_at_visit), na.rm = TRUE),
    cor = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$estimate,
    cor_ci_lo = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$conf.int[1],
    cor_ci_hi = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$conf.int[2],
    cor_t = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$statistic,
    cor_df = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$parameter,
    cor_p = cor.test(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var))$p.value,
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


age_tissue_plot <- ggplot(age_tissue_data, aes(x = age_at_visit, y = T0001)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.2, color = "gray30") +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = 40, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#0072B2", fill = "#0072B240", size = 1) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top", 
          size = 3, color = "black", digits = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = age_tissue_stats,
    aes(label = sprintf("n = %d\nRMSE: %.2f\nMAE: %.2f", n, rmse, mae)),
    x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", name = "Count", direction = -1) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray70"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, face = "italic"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 15, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Chronological and Predicted Age",
    subtitle = paste0("Analysis by tissue type (Total n = ", sum(age_tissue_stats$n), ")"),
    x = "Chronological Age (years)",
    y = "Predicted Age (years)",
    caption = "Note: Dashed line represents perfect prediction (y=x). Blue line shows linear regression with 95% confidence interval.
    RMSE = Root Mean Square Error; MAE = Mean Absolute Error. Higher density of observations shown in darker colors."
  )

# Save the plot
save_plot(age_tissue_plot, "Age_tissue_plot.png", width = 8, height = 5)
save_plot(age_tissue_plot, "Age_tissue_plot.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)

fwrite(age_tissue_stats,paste0(output_dir,"age_prediction_accuracy_by_tissue.txt"),
       sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
```

## Extended Data Fig. 2 (per-site age and MMSE, final print size)

One figure drawn at its final size, so all text is 5-7 pt (Nature artwork guide).
Uses the same data as Age_plot / MMSE_plot.

```{r ed2-figure}
library(patchwork)

ED2_W_MM <- 180; ED2_H_MM <- 175        # fits the 180 x 240 mm print area
ED2_NCOL <- 7

# per-site header: site, n, Pearson r, RMSE, MAE
ed2_strip <- function(d, x_var, y_var) {
  d %>%
    group_by(contributor_label) %>%
    summarize(
      n    = dplyr::n(),
      r    = cor(!!sym(y_var), !!sym(x_var)),
      rmse = sqrt(mean((!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var))^2)),
      mae  = mean(abs(!!sym(y_var) - !!sym(x_var))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # RMSE/MAE to 1 decimal so the line fits the narrow panels (full values: Source Data)
    mutate(strip = sprintf("%s\nn = %s, r = %.2f\nRMSE %.1f, MAE %.1f",
                           contributor_label, formatC(n, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
                           r, rmse, mae))
}

ed2_panel <- function(d, x_var, y_var, x_lab, y_lab) {
  s <- ed2_strip(d, x_var, y_var)
  d <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(contributor_label, all_of(c(x_var, y_var))) %>%
    left_join(s %>% dplyr::select(contributor_label, strip), by = "contributor_label") %>%
    mutate(strip = factor(strip, levels = s$strip[order(s$contributor_label)]))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = !!sym(x_var), y = !!sym(y_var))) +
    geom_bin_2d(bins = 30) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "#0072B2", fill = "#0072B2",
                alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ strip, scales = "free", ncol = ED2_NCOL) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = "Count") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.15),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "gray70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 5, lineheight = 0.9, margin = margin(1, 0, 1, 0)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 5, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "mm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6), legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.key.height = unit(5, "mm"), legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "mm")
    )
}

ed2_a <- ed2_panel(age_data, "age_at_visit", "T0001",
                   "Chronological age (years)", "Predicted age (years)")
ed2_b <- ed2_panel(mmse_data, "cognitive_test_score", "T0019",
                   "MMSE", "Predicted MMSE")

ed2 <- (ed2_a / ed2_b) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8, family = "Helvetica"))

# plain pdf device: vector, editable Helvetica text, no extra fonts needed on the AD Workbench
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "ED2_age_mmse_by_site.pdf"), ed2,
       width = ED2_W_MM, height = ED2_H_MM, units = "mm", device = "pdf")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "ED2_age_mmse_by_site.png"), ed2,
       width = ED2_W_MM, height = ED2_H_MM, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
